rules_text:
Rules summary Game Play On your turn, roll 1–3 dice matching the row colors. Everyone may use the total to fill a shape in a row that matches one of the dice colors, following two rules: Numbers must increase from left to right in a row. No number can repeat in a vertical column. You may skip placing a number, but the active player (the roller) must take a penalty if they do. Game End The game ends when someone fills two rows or marks four misthrows. Scoring Scoring is based on: Completed rows (score the rightmost number), Completed columns (score the pentagon), Partial rows (1 point per number), Misthrows (-5 points each). Highest score wins!
